candidate.version_description: Original is played using capo 3. The intro and instrumental is played the same way as a verse. The You Tube link is https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KVPGnJVkois.

[Intro]
[ch]Em[/ch]  [ch]A[/ch]  [ch]Em[/ch]
    [ch]D[/ch]  [ch]B[/ch]
[ch]Em[/ch]  [ch]D[/ch]  [ch]A[/ch]  [ch]B[/ch]
[ch]Em[/ch]     [ch]A[/ch]
[ch]Em[/ch]  [ch]B[/ch]  [ch]Em[/ch]


[Verse 1]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                    [ch]A[/ch]                  [ch]Em[/ch]
I was standin’ by the road in Black Jack County.[/tab]
[tab]                     [ch]D[/ch]                  [ch]B[/ch]
Not knowing that the Sheriff paid a bounty,[/tab]
[tab]    [ch]Em[/ch]              [ch]D[/ch]             [ch]A[/ch]              [ch]B[/ch]
For men like me who didn’t have a penny to their name.[/tab]
[tab]   [ch]Em[/ch]                [ch]A[/ch]
He locked my legs in 35 pounds[/tab]
[tab]   [ch]Em[/ch]         [ch]B[/ch]      [ch]Em[/ch]
Of Black Jack County chain.[/tab]


[Verse 2]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]            [ch]A[/ch]                 [ch]Em[/ch]
All we had to eat was bread and water,[/tab]
[tab]                   [ch]D[/ch]                [ch]B[/ch]
Everyday we had to build his road a mile and a quarter,[/tab]
[tab]  [ch]Em[/ch]                     [ch]D[/ch]
A black snake whip would sting our backs[/tab]
[tab]   [ch]A[/ch]                 [ch]B[/ch]
If some poor fool complained,[/tab]
[tab]       [ch]Em[/ch]                          [ch]A[/ch]
But we couldn’t fight back wearing 35 pounds[/tab]
[tab]   [ch]Em[/ch]         [ch]B[/ch]      [ch]Em[/ch]
Of Black Jack County chain.[/tab]


[Instrumental]
[ch]Em[/ch]  [ch]A[/ch]  [ch]Em[/ch]
    [ch]D[/ch]  [ch]B[/ch]
[ch]Em[/ch]  [ch]D[/ch]  [ch]A[/ch]  [ch]B[/ch]
[ch]Em[/ch]     [ch]A[/ch]
[ch]Em[/ch]  [ch]B[/ch]  [ch]Em[/ch]


[Verse 3]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                       [ch]A[/ch]             [ch]Em[/ch]
Then one night while the Sheriff lay a sleepin’,[/tab]
[tab]                [ch]D[/ch]                 [ch]B[/ch]
We all gathered round him, slowly creepin’,[/tab]
[tab]       [ch]Em[/ch]         [ch]D[/ch]                 [ch]A[/ch]                [ch]B[/ch]
Heaven help me to forget that night in the cold cold rain,[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]Em[/ch]                     [ch]A[/ch]
When we beat him to death with 35 pounds[/tab]
[tab]   [ch]Em[/ch]         [ch]B[/ch]      [ch]Em[/ch]
Of Black Jack County chain.[/tab]


[Verse 4]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                  [ch]A[/ch]               [ch]Em[/ch]
The wounds have all healed and I am thankful,[/tab]
[tab]                             [ch]D[/ch]               [ch]B[/ch]
And there’s nothing left but scars around my ankle.[/tab]
[tab]    [ch]Em[/ch]             [ch]D[/ch]             [ch]A[/ch]           [ch]B[/ch]
But best of all no man will ever be a slave again,[/tab]
[tab]     [ch]Em[/ch]                   [ch]A[/ch]
To a black snake whip and 35 pounds[/tab]
[tab]   [ch]Em[/ch]         [ch]B[/ch]      [ch]Em[/ch]
Of Black Jack County chain.[/tab]


[Outro]
[tab]    [ch]Em[/ch]             [ch]D[/ch]             [ch]A[/ch]           [ch]B[/ch]
